trans.sense: turned or twisted toward one side

glosses: Turned or twisted toward one side; crooked, distorted, out of place; wry.

examples.text: There is something awry with this story.
It came inside 50 minutes and moments later Cavani should have had a 12th. Pogba and Shaw combined before the left-back’s cross teed up the striker but his radar was awry.
examples.ref: 2021 April 29, Jamie Jackson, “Edinson Cavani and Bruno Fernandes help Manchester United hit Roma for six”, in The Guardian:

raw_glosses: (figurative) Wrong or distorted; perverse, amiss, off course
